figures.caption: Fig. 1. Comparison between geometry-only modeling and multi-source feature fusion. Geometry-only methods (left) primarily rely on coordinate information and struggle to distinguish inliers from outliers in complex scenes, resulting in unreliable matching results. In contrast, our proposed TriMatch (right) integrates texture semantic features from CNNs, structural semantic features from DINOv2, and coordinate-based geometric features, which enhances the discriminability of correspondence representations, achieving more reliable outlier identification.
